applies_why: The judge uses the fact that the cited texts do not state that Joseph begat the child as part of its reasoning holding the defense.
quote: neither text states that Joseph begat the child ([L4])
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.
room: 'single verse does not state a link': read as barring any verse-level non-statement from grounding STANDS, versus read as barring only an exactly one-verse non-statement.
why: The judge's holding relies in part on non-statement by the cited texts, which K-S2 forbids as a ground for STANDS.
